# `stars-data.json`: whose work it is

`stars-data.json` is a cut of three catalogues. It is licensed under
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/)
(CC BY-SA 4.0), as two of its sources are. That license covers this data
file, not the rest of the app.

- **Stars:** the [HYG database](https://www.astronexus.com/projects/hyg),
  version 4.1, by David Nash. CC BY-SA 4.0. Changed: cut down to stars of
  magnitude 6.5 or brighter (and the few fainter ones a constellation
  figure uses), keeping each one's position, magnitude and colour, and the
  proper names of the brighter ones.
- **Constellation figures:**
  [ConstellationLines](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10397192), version
  1.3, by Marc van der Sluys (hemel.waarnemen.com). CC BY 4.0. Changed:
  each star is given by its place in this file's list of stars, and seven
  faint companions of close doubles are joined at their brighter partners.
- **Messier, NGC and IC objects:**
  [OpenNGC](https://github.com/mattiaverga/OpenNGC), by Mattia Verga.
  CC BY-SA 4.0. Changed: cut down to Messier's objects and the others of
  magnitude 6.5 or brighter, keeping each one's name, kind, position,
  magnitude and size.
